hero.label: thefilip.com
hero.title: Hi, I'm Filip.
hero.subtitle: I make random stuff.
hero.text: iPhone apps, Mac apps, 3DS homebrew, CircuitPython drivers nobody else wrote, and way too many plane things. I build things because I want them to exist, then put them on the internet.

stats.l: Warsaw buses and trams to collect in TABOR

featured.name: TABOR
featured.desc: A Pokédex for Warsaw's buses and trams. Point the camera at one and its fleet number goes into your book as a die-cut sticker. The rarer the model, the louder it lands. A live map shows the ones you're still missing, and the Lock Screen tells you when one is about to reach your stop.

projects.name: Wattson
projects.desc: A menu bar battery that says what it's actually doing. Where every watt goes, and what's on the other end of each USB-C cable.

projects.name: BlockBlast3DS
projects.desc: Block Blast, the phone game, ported to the Nintendo 3DS as homebrew. It runs on old and new models, 2DS included.

projects.name: ffmep
projects.desc: ffmpeg as a Mac app that feels like it came with the Mac. Drop files in, pick a format, done. Also does HEIC, WebP, Live Photos and on-device background removal.

projects.name: Labeler
projects.desc: Printable sticker labels for 3D Benchys. Every Benchy deserves a name tag.

projects.name: ADSBnear
projects.desc: A little desk box that shows the nearest plane overhead on a 16×2 LCD: callsign, distance, type, altitude and speed, from live ADS-B data.

projects.name: PlaneGuessr
projects.desc: Is that a 737 or an A320? Guess the aircraft from its side profile. 60 aircraft from 13 manufacturers.

contribs.what: Ported CircuitPython to the Challenger RP2040 NFC, the only Challenger RP2040 board without it. It ships in the official builds, with its own page on circuitpython.org.

contribs.label: 27 merged
contribs.meta: The alert list ADS-B feeders run on
contribs.what: Added ~1,100 aircraft it was missing, from Polish Air Force MiG-29s to 293 V-22 Ospreys.

contribs.meta: 35k stars · coding agent with the IDE wired in
3.2k stars · bootable USB creator for Mac
contribs.what: Adding support for solid install.wim images when splitting Windows WIMs. The maintainer invited the PR.
Added configurable rumble style and strength.
Listed BlockBlast3DS, so it installs straight from Universal-Updater on the console.

minis.name: circuitpython-pn7150
minis.desc: NFC driver that reads and writes NDEF on basically every tag type, and can pretend to be a tag. In the Community Bundle.

minis.name: circuitpython-st25dv
minis.desc: The other end of NFC: a board on one side, a phone on the other, both reading the same memory. Also in the Bundle.

minis.name: FunPlaneViewer
minis.desc: A better viewer for every plane your ADS-B feeder has logged on SkyStats.

minis.name: Magic-Timer
minis.desc: Speedcubing timers are expensive and boring, so I'm building one with an OLED and NeoPixels.

minis.name: SPaaS
minis.desc: Shitposting as a Service. The future of brand loyalty.

minis.name: 1610.uk
minis.desc: A countdown to 16:10. It's .uk because the domain was cheap.
